plan.name: MY DOCTOR – Life Living Plan
plan.price_note: For inclusive benefits only. Benefits and pricing are subject to change without notice.
plan.provider: Medicall Healthcare, a product of Xperia Financial Services (PTY) Ltd (FSCA FSP No. 45551)
plan.registration_waiting_period: A 30-day registration period applies before benefits can be accessed.
plan.access_note: Every MY DOCTOR benefit is only accessible by calling the qualified nurse service.
plan.target_audience: All South African citizens wanting affordable, accessible private healthcare, in all 11 official languages, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

member_types.new: No existing Medicall Healthcare cover (or covered by another medical scheme). Pays the GP and pharmacy directly (own account) for the Virtual Doctor and Network GP benefits.
member_types.existing: Already a Medicall Healthcare member. The Virtual Doctor and Network GP benefits are fully inclusive, including formulary medication.

benefits.name: 24/7 Telephonic Medical Advisory Service
benefits.description: Qualified nurse assessment and treatment or referral advice, in all 11 official South African languages, 24 hours a day, every day of the year.

benefits.name: COVID Medical Advisory Services
benefits.description: 24-hour telephonic and WhatsApp COVID information, vaccine program guidance, and trauma or stress debriefing counselling.

benefits.name: Nurse Assistance Benefit
benefits.description: Consultation without diagnosis, following protocol, plus home-care guidance and advice on warning signs of deterioration.

benefits.name: Over-The-Counter Medication Benefit
benefits.description: Nurse-approved over-the-counter medication via Mediscor. The coupon is valid for 3 days. Up to 150 rand per pre-approval per month, capped at 1000 rand per year per family.

benefits.name: Virtual Doctor Consultation Benefit
benefits.description: Existing members: fully inclusive, including formulary medication. New members: pay the GP and pharmacy directly.

benefits.name: Referral to a Network GP Benefit
benefits.description: Existing members: inclusive. New members: own account.

benefits.name: 24/7 Land and Air Emergency Evacuation Benefit
benefits.description: Accident assessment, ambulance, medical response, or helicopter dispatch, pre-arrival first aid advice, inter-hospital transfer, and repatriation if hospitalized more than 100 kilometers from home, paid up to the elected benefit limit.

benefits.name: Trauma Counselling and Medical Advisory Benefit
benefits.description: Emergency first aid advice, poison information, and symptom assessment and referral, leading to ambulance escalation, home-care advice, a GP recommendation, or an emergency room referral.

faq.question: When can I start using my benefits?
faq.answer: There's a 30-day registration period before benefits become accessible.

faq.question: How do I access my benefits?
faq.answer: Every benefit is accessed by calling the qualified nurse service. For general queries, call 010 443 8777, or WhatsApp 063 986 5431.

faq.question: What's the difference between a new and an existing member?
faq.answer: Existing Medicall Healthcare members get the Virtual Doctor and Network GP benefits fully inclusive. New members pay the GP and pharmacy directly for those two benefits; every other benefit is inclusive either way.
